title: LabGPT
subtitle: Clinical Foundation Models
excerpt: Clinical prediction models can be effective but limited in medical context. LabGPT explores large models that reason over laboratory data with clinical nuance.

title: EXCELERATE
subtitle: Advanced Full Blood Count Analysis
excerpt: A foundation model approach for advanced full blood count interpretation, designed to improve diagnostic accuracy and support clinicians across the care pathway.

title: ACCENT
subtitle: Genes, Disease, and Prediction
excerpt: ACCENT studies relationships between genes and disease. The project builds AI tools that connect molecular signals to clinical decisions in a traceable way.

title: BloodCounts!
subtitle: Full Blood Count Intelligence
excerpt: The full blood count is essential in clinical decision-making. BloodCounts! develops AI-assisted analysis that makes these routine measurements more informative.
